Open DevTools ({{shortcut}}) on your Atlassian tab →
Application tab → Storage → Cookies → {{host}} →
find the row named "{{cookieName}}" (or "{{ssoCookieName}}"
on SSO tenants) → copy the Value cell → paste it below.
